title: CarveMix: A simple data augmentation method for brain lesion segmentation
mechanism: Carve an ROI around a lesion with random context margin from one labelled image and place it at the same coordinates in another labelled image, labels following, with harmonisation across sources.
adaptation: Same-location transfer works because cells of one type share geometry. ROI = crack or inactive component dilated by 8 to 40 px, source and target same source and cell type, both labelled; seam lies in labelled background, so seams are not tied to defects.
min_experiment: PF+CVM vs PF, 5 seeds + module-grouped CV; CV inactive IoU, test crack IoU, CP100 decoy rate. Kill: CV inactive < +0.02 and crack IoU < +0.012, or decoy rate > 2x PF.
evidence: Improves brain lesion Dice on several datasets (abstract); in Cut to the Mix +2.5 macro Dice on 20 CT volumes.
prior_overlap: CP100 pasted crack masks only (no context) onto unlabelled pool cells at random places; same-location ROI transfer between labelled cells is untested.
